_comment: Copy to fm_discover.config.json. Separate from the extractor's config because discovery creates tables, which the service account cannot do - so this one carries an ADMIN role for PostgreSQL. Keep it out of any synchronised folder.

filemaker._note: The same read-only account the extractor uses. Discovery only reads.

postgres._note: An administrative role, NOT svc_py. Needs CREATE on the dsc schema.

_tables_note: fm_discover takes the table on the command line and does not read a tables list. The key is present only because the extractor's config loader requires it.
